breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。

master.definition_en: A malignant neoplasm that arises from mesothelial cells in the pleura and shows a diffuse growth pattern. It arises on the parietal and sometimes visceral pleura as multiple small nodules that later become confluent and invade the chest wall adipose tissue and muscle. Asbestos exposure is the main cause for the development of pleural malignant mesothelioma. It usually affects patients over sixty years of age. The latency period is long. Patients usually present with pleural effusion, dyspnea and chest wall pain. Additional signs and symptoms include chills, sweating, weight loss, and weakness. Morphologic variants include epithelioid, desmoplastic, sarcomatoid, and biphasic mesothelioma. The clinical course is usually aggressive.

mechanisms: Vascular endothelial growth factor A inhibitor

master.definition_en: Autosomal recessive Alport syndrome isa genetic condition characterized by kidney disease, hearing loss, and eye abnormalities. Most affected individuals experience progressive loss of kidney function, usually resulting in end-stage kidney disease. People with Alport syndrome frequently develop sensorineural hearing loss in late childhood or early adolescence. The eye abnormalities seen in this condition seldom lead to vision loss. Alport syndrome can have different patterns of inheritance. About15 percentof Alport syndrome cases are inherited in an autosomal recessive pattern and are caused bymutations in both copies of the COL4A3 or COL4A4 genes. Treatment is based on the symptoms present and may include medications to delay the progression of kidney disease. In most cases, a kidney transplant is eventually needed.

curated.category: 恶性肿瘤 / 惰性皮肤T细胞淋巴瘤
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 最常见的原发性皮肤T细胞淋巴瘤（虽名“肉芽肿”，实为恶性淋巴瘤而非真菌感染），早期常长达数年甚至十余年仅表现为顽固红斑、鳞屑或瘙痒，极易误诊为湿疹、银屑病或体癣；病程总体慢性进展，但进入肿瘤期/红皮病期(Sézary综合征)或发生大细胞转化后，极易并发金黄色葡萄球菌败血症及内脏播散致命。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 早期（ⅠA–ⅠB期，占约70%）经外用激素、氮芥、光疗(NB-UVB/PUVA)等皮肤定向治疗即可长期控制，预期寿命接近正常人；中晚期（ⅡB–Ⅳ期）需联合系统维A酸、干扰素、甲氨蝶呤、维布妥昔单抗(CD30-ADC)或莫加利珠单抗(CCR4单抗)控制，5年生存率约40%–65%。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: GLOBOCAN未单列蕈样肉芽肿；全球年发病率约4–6/百万，占全部皮肤淋巴瘤约50%–60%，早期ⅠA期10年生存率超95%
annual_deaths_global.source: Orphanet ORPHA:2584 / EORTC Cutaneous Lymphoma Registry

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国无单列全国死亡统计；国内三甲皮肤科与血液科联合诊治中心近年检出率明显提升，但基层早期误诊率仍极高
annual_deaths_china.source: 《中国皮肤T细胞淋巴瘤诊治指南》

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 年发病率约0.4–0.6/10万，中位确诊年龄55–60岁，男女比约2:1（Orphanet ORPHA:2584）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 占中国原发皮肤淋巴瘤首位，从首发皮疹到确诊平均延误常达3–6年

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 1) 广泛皮肤破溃糜烂或红皮病伴高热寒战（高度警惕皮肤屏障破坏继发致命性金黄色葡萄球菌败血症/脓毒症休克）：立即留取血培养及皮损拭子培养，经验性静脉覆盖抗耐甲氧西林金葡菌(MRSA)抗生素并加强创面无菌护理; 2) 肿瘤期大细胞转化伴高肿瘤负荷化疗时警惕肿瘤溶解综合征。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 靶向CCR4单抗莫加利珠单抗与CD30-ADC维布妥昔单抗已成为中晚期MF/Sézary综合征国际标准，国内多中心真实世界研究进一步验证其清除血液肿瘤细胞的高效性; 2) 靶向CD47(巨噬细胞免疫检查点)、KIR3DL2(Lacutamab 2期TELLOMAK研究在Sézary综合征展示持久缓解)及JAK1/2抑制剂正在开展国际多中心试验; 3) AI皮肤镜图像识别结合浅层皮肤高通量TCR测序正显著缩短基层早期误诊时间。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 早期极易被误诊为慢性湿疹或银屑病，平均确诊延迟数年; 2) 除异基因移植外尚无药物可根治晚期肿瘤期/Sézary综合征，停药易复发; 3) 顽固剧烈皮肤瘙痒与外观损毁严重影响患者心理与社交生活。

master.definition_en: Ribbing disease is a rare bone disease that causes bony growths on the long bones, such as the thigh bone and shine bone.Ribbing diseaseaffects women more frequently than men. The most common symptom is pain. A single studyof 14 patients found an association between Ribbing disease and impaired exercise tolerance and changes in heart function (i.e., increased prevalence of arrhythmia and changes in left ventricular systolic and diastolic function).The cause of the condition iscurrently unknown, although some cases appear to be genetic and inherited in an autosomal recessive fashion.Optimal treatment for the disease is largely unknown. There have been case reports describingtreatment of Ribbing diseasewith bisphosphonate pamidronate. Results have been mixed. The conditionoften resolves on its own; howevercases of progressive disease have been described.

master.definition_en: Lattice corneal dystrophy type 3A is rare condition that affects the cornea. It is characterized primarily by protein clumps in the clear, outer covering of the eye which cloud the cornea and impair vision. Affected people also experience recurrent corneal erosion (separation of certain layers of the cornea), which is associated with severe pain and sensitivity to bright light. Lattice corneal dystrophy type 3A is caused by changes (mutations) in the TGFBI gene and is inherited in an autosomal dominant manner. The condition is usually treated surgically.
synonyms_en: lattice corneal dystrophy type III A
mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism

master.definition_en: Ring chromosome 22 is a rare condition caused by having an abnormal chromosome 22 that forms a ring. In this chromosome abnormality,a segment on the short (p) arm and a segment on the long (q) arm of 22 are missing. The amount of material lost varies from person to person. The remaining ends of chromosome 22 have joined together to make a ring shape. Chromosome 22 is an acrocentric chromosome, meaning that the centromere is near one end, creating a very small short (p) arm that does not contain genes that are relevant to development. Thus, only the lost genes on the long (q) arm matter. Knowing the breakpoint in the long arm is likely more helpful. Most cases are sporadic (happen by chance) and occur in people with no history of the condition in their family.

breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 神经退行性疾病（渐冻症 ALS、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森）、胶质母细胞瘤与纤维化器官病往往不是没发现靶点，而是大分子药进不去血脑屏障，或普通小分子误伤全身。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 突破跨血脑屏障转运体载体、GalNAc-siRNA / ASO 精密肝脏与中枢基因沉默调控、靶向蛋白降解嵌合体（PROTAC）及虚拟细胞药效预测技术。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 可穿屏障肽/纳米载体生成式设计、RNA 序列稳定与毒性预测、多组学虚拟细胞扰动响应仿真。

mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

master.name_en: neurodevelopmental disorder with speech delay, movement abnormalities, and seizures
master.definition_en: A neurodevelopmental disorder caused by a variation in the UNC13A gene, characterized by variable degrees of developmental delay and intellectual disability, seizures of various types, and tremor and dyskinetic movements, with death in early childhood in some cases.
synonyms_en: UNC13A-related neurodevelopmental disorder with seizures and movement disorder
